# Python script to extract the outgroup branches from the neo-sex gene trees. Assuming these branches represent autosomal genes in the outgroups, this can also be used to estimate mu_A within the same gene

```{python, eval=FALSE}
from pathlib import Path
from ete3 import Tree
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================
BASE_DIR = Path(".")
NEO_GENE_FILE = "neo_genes_values.tsv"

OUTGROUP_TAXA = ["Tae_gut", "Ans_ans"]  # terminal branches to pull


def get_terminal_branch_lengths(gene, base_dir=BASE_DIR):
    """
    Terminal (pendant) branch length to each outgroup tip. Unlike the
    stem/crown extraction, this does NOT require rerooting -- a leaf's
    own branch length is the same regardless of where the tree is rooted.
    """
    tree_file = base_dir / gene / f"{gene}_dS_tree.nwk"
    if not tree_file.exists():
        return {taxon: np.nan for taxon in OUTGROUP_TAXA}

    tree = Tree(str(tree_file))
    leaf_names = set(tree.get_leaf_names())
    result = {}
    for taxon in OUTGROUP_TAXA:
        if taxon in leaf_names:
            result[taxon] = tree.search_nodes(name=taxon)[0].dist
        else:
            result[taxon] = np.nan
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    df_neo = pd.read_csv(NEO_GENE_FILE, sep="\t")

    branch_data = df_neo["Gene"].apply(get_terminal_branch_lengths)
    branch_df = pd.DataFrame(list(branch_data))
    branch_df.columns = [f"{taxon}_branch_dS" for taxon in OUTGROUP_TAXA]

    df_out = pd.concat([df_neo, branch_df], axis=1)

    missing_fal = df_out["Tae_gut_branch_dS"].isna().sum()
    missing_ans = df_out["Ans_ans_branch_dS"].isna().sum()
    print(f">>> Missing Fal_per branch for {missing_fal}/{len(df_out)} genes")
    print(f">>> Missing Ans_ans branch for {missing_ans}/{len(df_out)} genes")
    if missing_fal or missing_ans:
        print("    (genes missing both will fall back to the borrowed-mu_A")
        print("     approach in the model -- see fusion_model_locus_matched.py)")

    out_file = NEO_GENE_FILE.replace(".tsv", "_with_outgroup_branches.tsv")
    df_out.to_csv(out_file, sep="\t", index=False)
    print(f">>> Saved {out_file}")

```
